description: This file defines the internal class CachedVersionSelectorManager, which manages cached version selection for grains in Orleans runtime, including methods for retrieving suitable silos based on grain type, interface, and version, as well as cache management.

classes.name: CachedVersionSelectorManager
classes.description: Manages cached version selection for grains, providing methods to get suitable silos and reset cache.

classes.name: CachedEntry
classes.description: Represents a cached entry containing version info and suitable silos for a specific grain interface and version.

methods.name: CachedVersionSelectorManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache and dependencies.

methods.name: GetSuitableSilos
methods.description: Retrieves suitable silos for a given grain type, interface, and requested version, utilizing cache.

methods.name: ResetCache
methods.description: Clears the cache of suitable silos.

methods.name: GetSuitableSilosImpl
methods.description: Internal method to compute suitable silos based on grain type, interface, and version.
